errors.evidence: The description states there are five other selected countries, but the chart shows six other countries besides Bulgaria: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Slovenia, Croatia, and Romania.
The description states there are six lines on the chart, but there are seven lines, one for each of the seven countries shown in the legend.
The legend is located in the top center-left area of the chart, not the top right corner.
The line for Estonia is described as 'твърда' (solid), but the legend and chart show it is a dashed line.
The line for Latvia is described as 'твърда' (solid), but the legend and chart show it is a dashed line.

The description claims the line for Lithuania falls to about 0.13% in 2017. However, the chart shows it ends at a much higher value, approximately 0.175%, which is also an increase from its value in 2015.
The line for Romania is described as 'твърда' (solid), but the legend and chart show it is a dashed line.
The description states that the line for Croatia reaches about 0.14% in 2017, but the chart shows its final value is lower, at approximately 0.12%.
